steps.explanation: Displacement is the change in the position vector - a new vector from the old point to the new one

spec.body_markdown:
## Position Vector

The position vector r locates an object relative to a chosen origin: r = xî + yĵ (or add z k̂ in 3D). Unlike other vectors, a position vector is always drawn starting at the origin.

When an object moves from r₁ to r₂, the displacement vector is Δr = r₂ - r₁ - a vector from the old position straight to the new one, regardless of the path actually traveled.
